title: Choose the visual world for Periscope
question: The roll assigned Grey Card & Step Wedge. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Grey Card & Step Wedge
options.lineage: Kodak grey card, step tablets and colour-control patches
options.thesis: Periscope is photometry of a grey floor, so the console is a calibration target: every reading is a measured patch.
options.viewport: The live floor sits on a grey-card field like a target under test, wedge drawn in registration ink, a step-wedge rule on its edge; beside it the spacetime strip as exposed film; the alarm floods a safelight-red band.
options.risk: Mid-grey can read dull or low-contrast if the patches and type are not fully committed.

raised.raise: The 90 angular bins show as a raw, unsmoothed bar field with tabular numbers, the data at full density.
The calibration wedge and an angle grid stay visible as the page's construction armature.
Every view registers to one time cursor and one angle scale, panels sharing a baseline.
No card chrome: panels are printed patches on the grey field, type and colour do the work.

options.label: Sonar Bearing-Time Console
options.lineage: naval sonar waterfall and bearing-time recorders
options.thesis: The spacetime image already is a sonar waterfall: bearing across, time falling down, contacts as traces.
options.viewport: A full-height waterfall dominates, the corner map as a quarter-circle bearing scope, contact readout in engraved mono.
options.risk: Familiar: near the dark-console-with-neon default most runs land on, and close to Quiver's world.

options.label: Junction Wayfinding Band
options.thesis: The corner is a junction sign: one yellow band says who is coming, from which side, how soon.
options.viewport: A monumental yellow band across the top with the hidden person's bearing and seconds-to-corner; the evidence panels hang below like secondary signs.
options.case: Operators recognise it instantly (holds audience); explains the alert, not the shadow physics (loses clarity).
options.risk: Can feel like signage cosplay if the evidence below is weak.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Pure black and white bar fields where the signal is the spectacle.
options.viewport: Strobing barcode of angle bins with dense numbers.
options.case: Judges admire it; nobody reads an alert from it; loses both axes.
options.kept: Raw data density: the angular bins as an honest bar field.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms built on a visible construction grid.
options.viewport: Grid-built display type over the console.
options.case: A type poster, not a sensor; loses both axes.
options.kept: The construction grid kept visible as armature.

options.label: Botanical Folio Plates
options.thesis: One subject through stages, every plate registered to the same scale.
options.viewport: Stage plates of the walk: far, near, at the corner.
options.case: Wrong world for warehouses and judges; loses both axes.
options.kept: Registration: every view on one time and angle scale.

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.thesis: Flat colour tiles and giant lowercase, chrome deleted.
options.viewport: Live tiles for angle, alert and quality.
options.case: Generic once fused; loses both axes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark monitoring dashboard: video tile, charts, status pills, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Header, video left, charts right, alert pill.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every CV demo by design.

resolved.via: structured question after the page closed
